text:
Kaya (People Ops): Quick drop  tiny 'goal signal' card + micro-review prompts for managers. Aim: make handoffs fast and surface hiring/promo signals. Pls quick-look.

Omar (Eng Manager): skimmed. can we force a single primary metric and one-line "why"? that helps calibration.

Kaya (People Ops): yes  Primary metric required + one-sentence why. Also added optional 'Career signal' (None/Develop/Promotion) and 'Hiring signal' (Y/N + need-by).

Yuna (IC): add an OOO + backup line please. last cycle we lost ownership during leaves.

Kaya (People Ops): done. sample card below for copy/paste: 

```
Goal (1-line): Reduce model-serving cost per 1M tokens
Why (1-sentence): Lower infra spend while keeping p95 latency stable
Primary metric: cost_per_1M_tokens <= $X (monthly avg)
Career signal: Develop (cross-team leadership growth)
Hiring signal: Y Role: Senior Infra Eng Need-by: 2026-09-01
Owners: Yuna (primary) / Omar (backup)
Est weekly focus: 15-25%
Planned OOO & Backup: Yuna OOO Sep 10-14; Omar covers canary
Dependencies: quantization experiment, autoscaler rollout
```

Felix (Recruiting): good format. if Hiring signal = Y please also add 'Role urgency' (low/med/high) and "Interview decider by" so we can route reqs.

Kaya (People Ops): added those fields and a tiny TL;DR managers can paste into calendar invites.

Omar (Eng Manager): what about peer feedback? need 3 bullet prompts that take <60s.

Kaya (People Ops): micro-peer prompts included: 
- One-line observed outcome
- One suggestion to amplify impact
- One quick offer to help next quarter
Optional: "One thing to stop" for calibration.

Yuna (IC): add a 3-item manager acceptance check (Y/N) so handoffs are consistent.

Kaya (People Ops): added manager quick-check: outcome-oriented? primary metric set? owners & backups clear? Y/N ticks.

NotifyBot: Resource update queued  templates will sync to Knowledge Hub within 24 hours.

Omar (Eng Manager): this looks ready. can you upload PDF + markdown + TL;DR to #docs and ping managers? i'll pilot in our kickoff tomorrow.

Kaya (People Ops): will do  uploading now and tagging manager group. thanks for the quick feedback!
